caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a decorative object composed primarily of two wide, draping black or dark gray ribbons or bands that extend vertically downwards and are placed parallel to each other. At the tops of these bands, there are large, overlapping, deep green or nearly black leaves, illustrated with visible vein details. Hanging from these leaves and bands are multiple ornate tassels, each consisting of an elongated golden-brown oval element resembling a bead, from which numerous strands of small, black or dark tassels are suspended. The tassels are spaced evenly and have a slight sheen, with golden fixtures attaching them to the leaf structure above. The background is plain and neutral, allowing the object to stand out clearly, and in the upper right portion, there is a faint, unfinished line sketch of a headpiece or veil with an indication of floral ornamentation, drawn in gray pencil. The composition is centered, with the primary decorative object occupying most of the space, and the color palette is limited to shades of black, gold, and brown, with subtle green accents for the leaves.
title: Headdress
